A1.justification: Both complete 17-page PDFs describe the same SALOVA and SceneWalk work. The main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, V-NIAH retrieval results, qualitative examples, and SceneWalk dataset analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical analyses and reports revised 7B benchmark results alongside the smaller models' retained results.

M1.justification: v1 specifies CLIP vision/text encoders; v2 introduces SigLIP for the frontier 7B configuration while retaining CLIP configurations. This is a localized component change: the connector, retrieval router, FocusFast pathways, objectives, and training stages remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Training datasets and task coverage are retained. Both versions evaluate Video-MME, LongVideoBench, ActivityNetQA, VideoChatGPT, MVBench, and V-NIAH, with the same SceneWalk data and qualitative scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds LongVA-7B as a Video-MME comparator, reporting 52.6 overall. LongVA was already cited in v1 but absent from that comparison. Other comparator sets remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported frontier 7B configuration changes from 336×336 inputs and 144 visual tokens per frame to 384×384 and 196 tokens. Appendix B and Table 5 now describe the 7B configuration specifically. Sampling, metrics, training budgets, and dataset splits otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 3 and 7 retain the same sampling, training-stage, FocusFast, and retrieval-number ablations with identical scores. Figure 3 retains the same V-NIAH heatmaps, and Figure 8 retains the same qualitative cases.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 revise the 7B results: Video-MME overall changes from 50.0 to 53.1, LongVideoBench validation from 43.5 to 44.6, ActivityNetQA accuracy/score from 55.6/3.6 to 53.6/3.5, VideoChatGPT from 3.09 to 3.13, and MVBench from 52.6 to 53.5. These accompany the encoder/resolution change and are not same-setting gains. LongVA results are added; smaller-model scores and Appendix Table 6's CLIP-based results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 1, its margin parameter, and Appendix A's correspondence thresholds and binary-union supervision construction are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about SceneWalk, targeted segment retrieval, and improved long-video understanding.

C2.justification: Section 5.3 explicitly connects the frame-sampling ablation's benefit to retrieving more frames through SR-Router, whereas v1 primarily explains it through higher frame count. The short-video efficiency limitation and Appendix D's explanation of retrieval-number saturation remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 documents the encoder choices by model size and scopes Appendix B to 7B. Table 6 identifies its retained 7B results as the CLIP variant, and Table 7 explicitly names the CLIP checkpoint. Hardware, optimizer settings, training-time estimates, and access links are retained.

R1.justification: The same 73 cited works and substantive research positioning remain. SigLIP and LongVA were already cited in v1; their additional appearances concern implementation and evaluation rather than a revised novelty argument.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized prose edits, corrects the stated number of LLM backbones from two to three, renames variants from Llama/Phi/Qwen to parameter-size labels, and adds acknowledgments. The section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains a comparator row; several table and figure labels or captions are updated, including the CLIP marker in Table 6. Figure 1 corrects WebBid-10M to WebVid-10M. Minor spacing and page-flow changes accompany these edits; the figure inventory and overall layout remain.

improvement.justification: The added LongVA comparison strengthens the empirical context, while the encoder/resolution documentation and Table 6's CLIP marker help readers distinguish configurations. These are useful but limited gains. The revised 7B scores are mixed and use a changed configuration, so they do not establish uniform or controlled performance improvements; the central analyses and validation remain largely unchanged.
